title: Into Thin Air
author: Jon Krakauer
summary: Jon Krakauer was a journalist on a commercial guided expedition to Everest in 1996 when a storm killed eight climbers. He gives a first-hand account of the climb and the disaster and wrestles with his own survivor's guilt.
readIf: you like high-altitude survival stories told by someone who was there.
skipIf: you find accounts of people dying of exposure and exhaustion upsetting.
